text.description_html:
Weslock 2165/2111, Modern Double Cylinder Handleset

The modern design of this Weslock made handleset makes it a great choice for the front doors of contemporary homes. The rectangular mounts and flowing lines come together to form an entryset that is very striking--both elegant and beautiful. It has a satin nickel finish that really accentuates its modern look.. A double cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from both the exterior and the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. Double cylinder entry sets are most often used on doors located near windows. Easy to install, it will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is key operated from both the interior and the exterior while the latch underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Also available matching:
Modern Single Cylinder Handleset
Modern Dummy Handleset

This modern handleset is from the Weslock Traditionale Collection which features solid brass construction and lifetime mechanical and finish warranties.

Features of the Weslock Double Cylinder Modern Entrance Set:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • Adjustable latches with removable faceplates.
  • 5-1/2" minimum center to center cross hole spacing
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Traditionale Collection Double Cylinder Modern Handleset:

  • Exterior Length: 18"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

Sold Individually
